# AliceLabs LLC

> Open-source infrastructure for AI agent trust, GovTech, legal AI, and security research. Wyoming-based. 100+ repositories, 21 public, 7 live sites.

## About
AliceLabs LLC is a Wyoming-filed company (Filing #2025-001849256) based at 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801. We build open-source infrastructure for AI agents, government APIs, legal tech, and security research.

## Core Technologies
- UTA (Universal Trust Adapter) v1.0 — translates between 8 trust credential formats
- ATC (Agent Trust Card) v1.0 — Ed25519-signed trust cards for AI agents
- MCP Vault Server — zero-trust key management for AI agents
- SAM.gov SDK — TypeScript SDK for federal contracting API
- Agent Trust Pipeline — verifiable reputation and credential layer

## Live Sites
- OpenSAM: https://opensam.us — Federal contract intelligence
- MarketNow: https://marketnow.site — Trust infrastructure for AI agents
- AliceLabs.Energy: https://alicelabs.energy — Energy platform
- SG-Turismo: https://sg-turismo.com — Tourism platform
- Equastore: https://equastore.com — Wellness store
- Angry Cactus: https://angrycactus.site — Lifestyle brand
- FloraNova: https://floranova.life — Botanical care
